ja: • 大井鐡動きかんしゃトーマス号は2014年夏、土日を中心に新金谷～千頭間を１日１往復して人気に。2015年夏も運行。
• きかんしゃトーマス号の客車増結用セット。「アニー」「クラベル」に合わせたオレンジ色。
• スハフ42×１両、オハ47×１両のセット。
en: • Oi Tetsu's Thomas the Tank Engine became popular in the summer of 2014, making 11 round trips between Shin-Kanaya and Senzu, mainly on soil. It will also operate in the summer of 2015.
• A set for adding additional passenger cars to the Thomas the Tank Engine. Orange color that matches "Annie" and "Clavelle".
• A set of Suhafu 42 x 1 car and Oha 47 x 1 car.
